item.title: Geofixe Data Leak Claim Lists 1,656 Records With Customer, Billing and Payment Information
item.description: An actor using the handle "ChimeraZ" claims to have leaked a database associated with Geofixe, a French telecommunications service that provides virtual landline numbers.
item.dc:creator: Dark Web Informer
item.content:encoded:
Data Exposure Report France Telecommunications Customer & Billing Data Leak Claim Unverified

Geofixe Data Leak Claim Lists 1,656 Records With Customer, Billing and Payment Information

Claimed lines1,656
Emails130
Phones56
Claimed size328 MB
Severity HIGH

Overview

An actor using the handle "ChimeraZ" claims to have leaked a database associated with Geofixe, a French telecommunications service that provides virtual landline numbers.

The listing advertises 1,656 lines in a 328 MB CSV dataset, with 130 email addresses and 56 phone numbers. The visible files include cards.csv, charges.csv, invoices.csv and people.csv, with samples showing customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, billing addresses, card-related fields, charge records and invoice/payment data. The dataset, its source, the stated counts and current availability have not been independently verified.

CountryFrance
SectorTelecommunications / virtual landline services
Actor"ChimeraZ"

Emails130
Phones56
Format / sizeCSV / 328 MB

What the post claims

  • 1,656 total lines
  • 130 email addresses
  • 56 phone numbers
  • 328 MB dataset size
  • CSV format
  • cards.csv referenced
  • charges.csv referenced
  • invoices.csv referenced
  • people.csv referenced
  • Customer names included
  • Email addresses included
  • Phone numbers included
  • Billing / postal addresses included
  • Card-related fields included

  • Invoice records included

The visible samples contain direct customer identity, contact, billing and payment information. Those individual values, invoice URLs, card-related values and payment references are not transcribed in this report.

No malware hash, Tox ID, Session ID or attacker-controlled IP address is visible in the supplied screenshot. Customer identifiers, payment links and direct download mirrors shown in the source material are intentionally not reproduced here.

Mapped techniques

Claimed identifies behavior explicitly described by the actor. Inferred identifies an analytical mapping supported by the supplied material. Neither label means the activity has been independently verified.

  • Collection T1213.006 Data from Information Repositories: Databases Inferred The listing presents structured CSV datasets containing people, card, charge and invoice information. The supplied material does not disclose how the data was obtained or independently establish unauthorized access to Geofixe systems.

Potential impact

If authentic, the claimed dataset could expose customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, billing records, card-related information and invoice/payment metadata. That combination could support targeted phishing, identity fraud, payment fraud, impersonation or other customer-focused abuse.

Status Unverified

Dark Web Informer has not independently verified the dataset's authenticity, source, completeness, 1,656-line count, email or phone totals, 328 MB size, sample contents or current availability. The supplied screenshot documents the listing and visible samples, not independent confirmation of the underlying data.

item.title: Lithos DEX Database Sale Claim Lists 173,146 Wallet Addresses and 50,239 IP Addresses
item.description: An actor using the handle "ChimeraZ" claims to be selling a database associated with Lithos, described in the listing as a decentralized exchange built on the Plasma blockchain.
item.dc:creator: Dark Web Informer
item.content:encoded:
Data Exposure Report Cryptocurrency DEX User Data Wallet & IP Data For Sale Unverified

Lithos DEX Database Sale Claim Lists 173,146 Wallet Addresses and 50,239 IP Addresses

Claimed lines173,146
Wallet addresses173,146
IP addresses50,239
Claimed size411 MB
SeverityHIGH

Overview

An actor using the handle "ChimeraZ" claims to be selling a database associated with Lithos, described in the listing as a decentralized exchange built on the Plasma blockchain.

The post advertises 173,146 records collected from 2025 to 2026. It lists 173,146 wallet addresses, 134,325 usernames, 112,436 names, 50,239 IP addresses and records spanning 142 countries. The archive is described as 411 MB in JSONL format. The dataset, its source, the stated counts and current availability have not been independently verified.
